WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT 
    o.mktnote,
    (f.feerate - f.rebrate) as net_fee_rate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) as overall_avg_rate
  FROM matched_fees
  WHERE net_fee_rate IS NOT NULL
),
pair_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    mktnote,
    AVG(net_fee_rate) as pair_avg_rate
  FROM matched_fees
  WHERE net_fee_rate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY mktnote
),
qualifying_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pair_stats.pair_avg_rate,
    (pair_stats.pair_avg_rate - overall_avg.overall_avg_rate) as excess
  FROM pair_stats, overall_avg
  WHERE pair_stats.pair_avg_rate > overall_avg.overall_avg_rate
    AND overall_avg.overall_avg_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  AVG(pair_avg_rate) as mean_of_average_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(excess) as mean_excess
FROM qualifying_pairs;

assumptions.assumption: Output is a single aggregated row: the mean of all qualifying pairs' average net fee rates, and the mean of all their exceedances above the overall average

alternatives.interpretation: Return one row per qualifying pair showing: trading pair identifier, that pair's average net fee rate, and that pair's excess above the overall average
